signIn.heading: Welcome back.
signIn.subheading: Sign in to manage your sessions.
signIn.errorVerify: Please verify your email before signing in.
signIn.errorGeneric: Sign in failed. Please try again.
signIn.errorAttempts: Incorrect email or password. You have {remaining, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left before your account is locked.

signUp.heading: Create account.
signUp.subheading: Join Essentia to manage your sessions.
signUp.errorGeneric: Sign up failed. Please try again.

verify.heading: Check your email.
verify.errorAttempts: That code is not right. You have {remaining, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left before verification closes.
verify.errorTooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes. Verification is closed for now — wait a few minutes and ask for a new code.

signUp.errorThrottled: Too many attempts from here. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

forgotPassword.heading: Reset your password.
forgotPassword.subheading: Enter your email and we'll send you a code.
forgotPassword.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reset.heading: Enter your new password.
reset.errorAttempts: That code is not right. You have {remaining, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left before this reset closes.
reset.errorTooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes. This reset is closed for now — wait a few minutes and start again.

forgotPassword.errorThrottled: Too many reset requests. Please wait a few minutes before asking for another code.

resetPassword.heading: Set a new password.
resetPassword.subheading: Choose a strong password for your account.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
resetPassword.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

unlocked.heading: Your account is open again.
unlocked.body: We have unlocked it and sent you a confirmation. Sign in with your usual password.

expired.heading: The lock had already lifted.
expired.body: Locks expire on their own after 30 minutes, and this one is long past. Go ahead and sign in.

invalid.heading: This link no longer works.
invalid.body: Unlock links can only be used once. If your account is still locked, try to sign in and we will email you a new one.
